typed_links.link: 022's mid-verse girding imperative and 014's decapitated וַיֹּ֣אמֶר at 5:20 are the same failure: quoting reported speech while the verse's actual clause-initial construction goes uncited. The repaired standard — quote from the verse's true head — is the peer's first cross-cutting ruling; the full governed list lives in peer_cluster_13.json.

076's 'pattern that closes every reign' was falsified by 077's own Amon close one row later — adjacent rows carried each other's counterexamples. Book-wide claims bind only after a book-wide tally (peer cross-cutting ruling 2; fourteen decisions governed, list in peer_cluster_13.json).

048 let a single-witness pe carry an edge whose verse held an uncited tier-1 citation formula — the book's one mark-as-sole-support defect; 003's repaired double-petuchah disclosure at 1:17/1:18 is the model: marks disclosed two-sidedly, MT-numbered, single-witness tagged, never drivers (peer cross-cutting ruling 3).

The 16:6 aside that cost 051 its high tier is structurally identical to the 15:37 aside 050 already disposed of: asyndetic temporal frames inside a span are engaged by name — argued as contained or conceded as seams — never passed in silence (peer cross-cutting ruling 4; also resolved at 072's arrival formula and 075's oracle pivot).

093's 'verb-initial clauses' fell to its own verses while 094 held the same edge on register content — when a syntactic description fails collation, the boundary must already rest on something true. Clause-type, person, and content labels enter rows only as parsed (peer cross-cutting ruling 5).

A three-miscounted-as-four at 4:41 and a false 'shortest' among tied three-verse oracles at 19:32-34: counts and ranges enter rows only from an actual tally (peer cross-cutting ruling 6; the ketiv/qere disclosure repairs at 088/090 belong to the same hygiene class).

The thrice-repeated bed-of-death sentence of 1:4/1:6/1:16 is discharged by 1:17's כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֣ה — oracle and fulfillment across the seam, recorded as relation, never merger. 003's frame also continues the reign opened at 1Kgs 22:51-53 (cross-book note carried from the 1Kgs close, non-authorizing).
The three arrow-strikes of 13:18-19 are discharged by 13:25's שָׁלֹ֤שׁ פְּעָמִים֙ notice — sign-act and fulfillment bracketing the Elisha death complex.
17:5-6's fall of Samaria is resumed verbatim by the 18:9-12 retrospect (shared Hoshea synchronism string) — Wiederaufnahme across the Hezekiah opening, a continuity relation with no unit force.

The Bethel altar fulfillment of 23:16-18 discharges the 1Kgs 13:2 oracle across books, and 097's release notice runs synoptic with Jer 52:31-34 — both cross-book pointers recorded for the atlas feed, neither authorizing anything here.
